claims.statement: A grand jury indicted Tom Allen for murder in the killing of Tim Confoy.
claims.excerpt: Pugilist Tom Allen were indicted for murder Wednesday afternoon

claims.statement: Tom Allen was a former champion pugilist.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, Former Champion Pugilist, and Ex-Detective Jack Williams

claims.statement: Allen shot Tim Confoy to death in his saloon during a quarrel.
claims.excerpt: Allen shot Tim Confoy to death in h's Saloon recently during a quarrel.

claims.statement: After a preliminary hearing in the Court of Criminal Correction, Allen was discharged on a plea of self-defense.
claims.excerpt: arrested and given a preliminary hearing in the Court of Criminal Correction, after which he was discharged, his plea being self-defense.
places: Court of Criminal Correction, St. Louis

notes: The grand jury indicted Allen; the paper does not give the date of the preliminary hearing. Williams is part of this article but not part of Allen's record.
